environment.description: Deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Container runs with task role granting read/write to the /var/data volume (EFS mount). ALB has no additional rule groups attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to container on 8080. No additional request filtering or transformation is configured on the ALB listener.
